subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — requested commercial terms and timeline
messages:
From: Gemma Harris <gemma@stellahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — draft and ask

Marissa --

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The team is aligned on running a 6-week evaluation (clinical workflows + patient messaging volume) and we sketched a MAP during the call. Attached is our internal procurement note and a one-page doc that shows target milestones.

Two asks on our side before we move forward with the pilot sign-off:
- Can Redwood commit to the evaluation pricing listed on slide 2 (1-month trial pricing then ramp pricing)?
- We would need a discount for the first-year ARR if we commit to a 3x ramp by Q4. Who needs to sign off? Our finance team requires a written approval path.

If possible, can you send the MAP (formalized) and the commercial ask (discount % + commit levels) by EOD Thursday? Procurement wants to queue this for the Aug 26 vendor committee.

Best,
Gemma
Procurement Lead, Stella Health
[Attachment: stella-procurement-note.pdf (PDF)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Gemma Harris <gemma@stellahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — draft and ask

Gemma —

Appreciate the clear asks and the procurement note. I attached a draft MAP (stella-MAP-v2.pdf) that breaks the 6-week evaluation into three milestones with acceptance criteria and measurement windows. High level commercial proposal:

- Evaluation (6 weeks): flat trial fee $8k covering up to 2M tokens and technical integration support.
- Post-trial ramp: commit to 3x usage by end of Q4; proposed starter discount 15% off list for year 1 if commit is signed within 30 days of pilot acceptance.
- Additional volume rebate: incremental 5% rebate if usage hits the 3x ramp within 90 days of go-live.

We can tighten the language around the rebate/commit in the SOW. Per your ask on sign-off, I am looping in Ben (my manager) and Aditya (VP Sales) for internal approval of the discount and any additional commercial concessions. Laura Bennett (CFO) will need to sign-off on >20% cumulative discounts or any multi-year credit exposure — I will ping her if we propose stepping past 15%.

I propose the following next steps:
1) I send the formal MAP + SOW draft to your procurement by Thursday EOD (attached).
2) Ben/Aditya/Laura review the discount ask; if needed we escalate to CFO/CEO for one-off credits.
3) If approved, we share a DocuSign-ready SOW and target the Aug 26 vendor committee.

Notes: I included a short revenue-commit summary workbook for internal review (revenue-commit-summary.xlsx).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: stella-MAP-v2.pdf (PDF); Attachment: revenue-commit-summary.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — draft and ask

Marissa / Aditya —

Reviewed the MAP and the proposed pricing. For Stella (strategic mid-market payer), I am comfortable approving a 15% introductory discount for year 1 tied to the 3x ramp commit. That aligns with our standard ramp incentive and keeps runway intact. The additional 5% rebate is OK as a performance-based payout after the ramp triggers.

Laura — can you confirm we have capacity against expected ARR exposure if we approve the rebate? If not, Marissa, we'll need to flag this as an escalated commercial concession that requires CFO sign-off.

If Laura gives the thumbs up, I'll authorize Marissa to present the signed MAP and SOW to Stella's vendor committee.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 10:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — draft and ask

Ben / Marissa —

Quick finance check: I ran a sensitivity against the revenue-commit workbook. Approving a 15% introductory discount + a conditional 5% volume rebate (paid after verification of the 3x ramp within 90 days) is acceptable for FY27 exposure given the expected ramp profile and churn assumptions. Conditions:
- Rebate paid only after usage is validated in our telemetry and after the third billing cycle post-go-live.
- Any multi-year credits or billing terms that push revenue recognition beyond 12 months require separate review.

Marissa — you have CFO approval on the structure above. Please ensure the SOW includes the verification clause for the rebate and the commit thresholds. If Stella asks for an up-front credit or a multi-year discount slice, escalate back to me before signing.

Laura Bennett
CFO, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Gemma Harris <gemma@stellahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP & evaluation plan — requested commercial terms and timeline

Gemma — attaching the finalized MAP and SOW for your procurement committee. Per internal approvals: Redwood will sign the MAP with the following commercial terms for the evaluation and first year:

- Evaluation: $8k flat trial fee (covers integration support + up to 2M tokens).
- Year 1 starter discount: 15% off list pricing if a signed commit is returned within 30 days of pilot acceptance.
- Performance rebate: additional 5% rebate applied retroactively if usage hits the 3x ramp within 90 days of go-live; rebate paid after verification per the SOW.

Laura has confirmed the finance guardrails and Ben has authorized execution at these levels. Attached DocuSign and SOW are ready; if procurement wants any language tweaks we can iterate quickly but this is the approved commercial path.

Next steps:
1) Gemma / Stella procurement to review MAP + SOW.
2) If OK, counter-sign in DocuSign and we target an Aug 31 start for the evaluation.
3) I'll coordinate a technical kickoff and add the integration owner to the MAP.

Thanks — excited to move this forward.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-draft-SOW.docx (DOCX); DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/preview/abc123]
